posts.title: Automating Display Sleep and Wake on macOS
posts.description: In my home office I have a "Late 2012" Mac Mini that serves to display my surveillance cameras, a live view of my webserver logs, and of course Dali Clock . Because it is a passive display, I have all the power saving stuff and display lock turned off. I sometimes remember to turn the monitor off when I leave... sometimes.
